title: JSM2 Supplemental Project 4: Debugging Functions Solution

panels.JavaScript:
/* Write the 6 following functions in arrow notation. 

Then, use printToScreen() to print sentences onto the screen using the functions. For example, "The sum of 4 and 6 is 10".

1. Write a function that takes in two numbers and returns their sum.

2. Write a function that takes in two numbers and returns their difference.

3. Write a function that takes in three numbers and returns the product of the numbers.

4. Write a function that takes in two numbers and returns their average.

5. Write a function that takes in a number and returns its factorial.

6. Write an exponent function that takes in a base and a power and returns the value of the base raised to that power.
*/

// Enter your code below this line



// DO NOT ALTER CODE WRITTEN BELOW THIS LINE

function printToScreen (text) {
	let r = Math.floor(Math.floor(Math.random() * 255 + 1));
	let g = Math.floor(Math.floor(Math.random() * 255 + 1));
	let b = Math.floor(Math.floor(Math.random() * 255 + 1));
	const svg = d3
		.select("body")
		.append("svg")
		.attr("width", 1500)
		.attr("height", 75);

	svg
		.append("text")
		.attr("y", 37.5)
		.attr("width", 450)
		.attr("height", 75)
		.attr("x", -1000)
		.attr("font-weight", "bold")
		.attr("font-size", "20px")
		.attr("fill", `rgb(${r},${g},${b}`)
		.attr("font-family", "Roboto")
		.text(text)
		.transition()
		.duration(1000)
		.attr("x", 37.5);
}
